@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The championship title was at s______e, so both teams entered the match with extreme focus and determination.
= stake
~詞義 stake（n.）至關重大(at stake)
~原文 The championship title was at stake, so both teams entered the match with extreme focus and determination.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Amy is a r______l person. She never acts on impulse or behaves emotionally.
= rational
~詞義 rational（adj.）理性的
~原文 Amy is a rational person. She never acts on impulse or behaves emotionally.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: With the development of online banking, you can now perform t______ns on your laptop and smartphone, which is quite convenient.
= transactions
~詞義 transaction（n.）交易
~原文 With the development of online banking, you can now perform transactions on your laptop and smartphone, which is quite convenient.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Penny was a______ted by a stranger on the street, and a witness immediately called the police.
= assaulted
~詞義 assault（v.）襲擊
~原文 Penny was assaulted by a stranger on the street, and a witness immediately called the police.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The wealthy man established a foundation that is dedicated to the c______n of marine life.
= conservation
~詞義 conservation（n.）保育
~原文 The wealthy man established a foundation that is dedicated to the conservation of marine life.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The lesson was ______ by a series of loud construction noises from the street, so the teacher decided to end class early.
A: confronted
B: disrupted
C: grilled
D: rattled
= B
~詞義 disrupt（v.）中斷
~原文 The lesson was disrupted by a series of loud construction noises from the street, so the teacher decided to end class early.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Even after a long three-hour meeting, the two companies still couldn't reach a ______.
A: consensus
B: discourse
C: lawsuit
D: ranch
= A
~詞義 consensus（n.）共識
~原文 Even after a long three-hour meeting, the two companies still couldn't reach a consensus.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The hikers were trapped on the mountain for seven days. Fortunately, they knew how to survive in the ______.
A: briefcase
B: realism
C: stance
D: wilderness
= D
~詞義 wilderness（n.）荒野
~原文 The hikers were trapped on the mountain for seven days. Fortunately, they knew how to survive in the wilderness.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The factory upgraded their manufacturing process, and the managers expected to increase ______ by 50%.
A: laser
B: notion
C: output
D: windshield
= C
~詞義 output（n.）生產量
~原文 The factory upgraded their manufacturing process, and the managers expected to increase output by 50%.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The shirt is quite new and in good condition, except for a little ______ on the right sleeve.
A: realm
B: norm
C: stain
D: wig
= C
~詞義 stain（n.）汙漬
~原文 The shirt is quite new and in good condition, except for a little stain on the right sleeve.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: envision
B: genre
C: glare
D: obligation
E: pandemic
F: witty

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: Ms. Lin asked us to ______ what we want to be in ten years and then write down the things we need to do in order to achieve this.
= A
~詞義 envision（v.）想像
~原文 Ms. Lin asked us to envision what we want to be in ten years and then write down the things we need to do in order to achieve this.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: The ______ uncovered weaknesses in healthcare systems and thus prompted governments to reconsider public health policies.
= E
~詞義 pandemic（n.）大流行病
~原文 The pandemic uncovered weaknesses in healthcare systems and thus prompted governments to reconsider public health policies.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: Maya is a smart and ______ person who tells great stories. Everyone enjoys chatting with her.
= F
~詞義 witty（adj.）機智風趣的
~原文 Maya is a smart and witty person who tells great stories. Everyone enjoys chatting with her.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: Science fiction is Henry's favorite ______. He has a whole shelf full of science-fiction novels.
= B
~詞義 genre（n.）文類
~原文 Science fiction is Henry's favorite genre. He has a whole shelf full of science-fiction novels.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: All citizens have the legal ______ to pay taxes to the government.
= D
~詞義 obligation（n.）義務
~原文 All citizens have the legal obligation to pay taxes to the government.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: confrontation
B: startling
C: landlord
D: exclaimed
E: stalled
F: transition

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: The ______ period between childhood and adulthood can be quite confusing and chaotic for some teenagers.
= F
~詞義 transition（n.）轉變
~原文 The transition period between childhood and adulthood can be quite confusing and chaotic for some teenagers.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: Mark wants to speak to his ______ about fixing the washing machine in his apartment, but he can't find him.
= C
~詞義 landlord（n.）房東
~原文 Mark wants to speak to his landlord about fixing the washing machine in his apartment, but he can't find him.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: When we heard what had happened to Cindy on the train this morning, we all ______ in surprise.
= D
~詞義 exclaim（v.）驚叫
~原文 When we heard what had happened to Cindy on the train this morning, we all exclaimed in surprise.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: This science experiment produced ______ results, which pushed the research forward by years.
= B
~詞義 startling（adj.）驚人的
~原文 This science experiment produced startling results, which pushed the research forward by years.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: The project ______ after funding was cut, and several important tasks were left unfinished for months.
= E
~詞義 stall（v.）停止進展
~原文 The project stalled after funding was cut, and several important tasks were left unfinished for months.
